title: fumaria media var. muralis
intro: Fumaria media var. muralis, commonly known as wall fumitory, is a variety of the Fumaria media plant, which belongs to the Fumariaceae family of flowering plants. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of wall fumitory include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic activities, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
